items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Gene Ramey) does not mention Eddie Barefield directly. The interviewer mentions Barefield in the context of the Blue Devils band, and the interviewee confirms the band name ('The Blue Devils, right') but discusses a third party ('he') who tried to get an interview with someone else.

ctx.x: I can't put a finger on it right now.
It's not —, uh, yeah, Eddie Barefield (phonetic) had sump'n to do with that band, didn't he?
